stories.title: Sources: Klay set to join Heat after Mavs buyout
stories.summary: Klay Thompson is expected to sign with the Heat after clearing waivers following his contract buyout from the Mavericks, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Seahawks WR Bobo suffers 'serious' knee injury
stories.summary: Seahawks wideout Jake Bobo appeared to suffer a "serious knee injury during Friday's practice against the Titans, coach Mike Macdonald told reporters.

stories.title: Mass. to investigate Cards exec's alleged betting
stories.summary: A second investigation has been opened related to former Arizona Cardinals scout Ryan Gold's alleged betting activity.

stories.title: Paredes among Argentines banned for WC brawl
stories.summary: Three Argentina players have been banned for their part in a brawl at the end of last month's World Cup final against Spain, but the South American nation has been fined only for displaying a Falkland Islands banner after the semifinal win over England.
